title: Sandustry Tips — Quick Habits for Cleaner Factories
description: Short Sandustry tips for Early Access: dig discipline, filters, saves, and when to rebuild.

paragraphs: Dig for a goal (space, resource, fluid control), not for dopamine tunnels.
Place filters before you think you need them.
Leave walkways and rebuild lanes — pixel bases get entombed.
Snapshot or save before terraforming under critical belts.
When stuck, watch one junction for 30 seconds instead of adding more machines.
Use the demo to profile your PC before a long EA session.
Bookmark Steam news and the official wiki for patch-sensitive numbers.
Join Discord or Reddit for layout screenshots, not as a substitute for reading tooltips.

faq.a: Automate the step you hate clicking first. Everything else is decoration until flow is stable.
